tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Turbine Valves Spares.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have supplied Turbine Valves Spares to 500 MW or above power plant value Rs. 4.70 lakhs or above in a single order during previous five years 2021-22 to 2025-26. As a proof furnish signed past Purchase Order copies placed by any Govt. sector/ PSU/ Reputed Private sector/ major industry
The bidder shall be BHEL/BHEL approved sub vendor /NTPC registered vendor/KPCL vendor for 500MW and above thermal power station Turbine Spares. The Agency shall furnish documentary proof

Bidder should have proven financial capability and have an average annual turnover of Rs. 9.40 lakhs for any two years among previous five years 2021-22 to 2025-26. The bidder shall furnish a copy of turnover certificate / Profit and loss statement duly certified by a charted accountant to establish annual turnover requirement stipulated above.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Supplier shall furnish dimensional guarantee certificate and interchangeability certificate. In case of any difficulty in fitment of spares due to manufacturing defects the agency shall replace or rectify the same on free of cost
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Dimensional guarantee certificate and interchangeability certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Dimensional guarantee certificate and interchangeability certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Supplier shall furnish material test certificate for MOC, UT & DP report, heat treatment report and other test certificate wherever applicable
The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed
Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Dimensional guarantee certificate and interchangeability certificate
